summary: Read the complete markdown conversion through its final references and checked every source page cited by the two requested elaboration estimates against the PDF. Confirmed main-test U = 924.0, p = 0.005 (PDF p. 8) and immediate-post-test U = 970.0, p = 0.012 (PDF p. 9), both for the full Experimental AI group versus Control non-AI group elaboration contrast, with greater elaboration in the control group. The reported valid sample supports n_treatment = 52, n_control = 52, n_total = 104 and n_units = 52 dyads (PDF p. 6); the methods describe all dyads completing both tests. The remaining null statistical fields are appropriate under the rule against extracting numbers available only in figures. The question, construct, measure, unit, higher_is, outcome_with_ai, outcome_timing, within_person and comparison_type codes are supported: researcher-coded elaboration of team outputs, with AI during the main test and without AI during the same-session immediate post-test, compared between the original randomized arms. The only retained problems are the two invalid, unresolved se_basis entries. All four script quote-not-found flags are false positives: the flexibility and originality main-test quotes are present on PDF p. 8, Section 5.1.1, and the H2 quote used by both immediate-test estimates is present on PDF p. 4, Section 3. Each matches exactly after joining words split by PDF soft hyphens (U+00AD) and normalizing whitespace. The completeness check found all four AUT dimensions at each of the main, immediate and retention occasions represented by the 12 existing estimates. No additional eligible full-sample outcome or contrast was found in the supplied paper; the AI-only pre-study, top-quartile comparisons, self-reports and process associations are appropriately excluded.
